title: Gluing constructibility of $f^!K$ and restricting the adjunction
statement:
Fix a prime $\ell$, a field $k$ of characteristic $p>0$ with $p\ne\ell$, and a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ inside a fixed algebraic closure $\Qlb=\overline{\mathbf Q}_\ell$. Let $X,Y$ be separated schemes of finite type over $k$ and $f:X\to Y$ a separated finite-type $k$-morphism, in the standing setting [sk-def-sfb-dc-setting]. Let $\Lambda=E$ or $\Qlb$. For $E$, use the condensed ring $S\mapsto C(S,E)$ on profinite sets, with the $\ell$-adic topology [sk-def-sfb-condensed-ring]. For $\Qlb$, use [sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed]: its sections on a profinite set $S$ are the continuous maps $S\to\Qlb$ whose image is contained in some finite subextension of $\mathbf Q_\ell$. Pull these rings back to the scheme pro-étale topoi [sk-def-sfb-pulled-back-coefficients] and use their module-object coefficients. Use $D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$ and $\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ as in [sk-def-sfb-constructible], the full localizing closures of [sk-def-localizing-closure], and the compact-support functor $Rf_!$ with right adjoint $f^!$ supplied by [sk-prop-sf-existence].

1. Let $M\in D(X_{\mathrm{proét}},\Lambda)$ and let $X=\bigcup_{\alpha\in I}U_\alpha$ be a finite open cover with $M|_{U_\alpha}\in\Dbc(U_\alpha,\Lambda)$ for all $\alpha\in I$. Then $M\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$.
2. For $K\in\Dbc(Y,\Lambda)$, $f^!K\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$, and for $A\in\Dbc(X,\Lambda)$ the adjunction bijection restricts naturally to
$$
\Hom_{\Dbc(Y,\Lambda)}(Rf_!A,K)\simeq\Hom_{\Dbc(X,\Lambda)}(A,f^!K).
$$

proof.text: Make X and Y Noetherian using finite type over the field and quasi-compactness. Convert the prime-characteristic hypotheses to ringChar k. The two coefficient alternatives give exactly the finite-extension and finite-subextension-valued algebraic-closure cases of localizingClosure_ctf_equals_bc. Its Dctf = Dbc equality proves finite Tor amplitude and the inclusion of Dbc into the intersection defining the localizing closure. The existing admissible-coefficient predicate, repaired in the A4 landing, includes this algebraic-closure coefficient explicitly, without identifying it with all continuous maps.

For an arbitrary finite open cover, transport bounded constructibility from mapDerivedCategory to leftDerivedFunctor using leftDerivedUpperStarIsoMapDerivedCategory and the isomorphism-closed property of Dbc. Apply bounded_finiteOpenDescent and cohomology_finiteOpenDescent. These coefficient-independent proved lemmas implement the boundedness and stratification arguments, including empty schemes and empty covers. Their conjunction is the defining predicate constantModelBoundedConstructible.

Apply compactification_localizing to the supplied boundary compactification and the now admissible rational coefficient. Convert a Dbc source object to Dctf by step 1 and retain the bounded constructibility component of the resulting Dctf object. This supplies hF for the actual compactification composite.

Apply restrictionLocal to the supplied G and adjunction. It supplies a finite affine chart cover and closed factorizations over affine target charts. Replace each affine source chart by its open range through isoOpensRange; compose the inverse isomorphism with the closed immersion and verify the factorization equations. These are again separated finite-type schemes over k: open immersions preserve local finite type and separatedness, and Noetherianity gives quasi-compactness. Finite-dimensional affine-space projections are locally of finite presentation and affine. Choose boundary compactifications of the projection and closed immersion using compactificationOverField. Apply exists_localizingExceptionalAdjoint to supply the auxiliary adjoints required by restrictionLocal. Its preservation clause now gives bounded constructibility of every open restriction of G K. Transport from leftDerivedFunctor to mapDerivedCategory and apply the same finite-cover descent from step 2 with the Fin n index type. Membership proofs in the full subcategory are propositionally irrelevant, so this is the supplied G applied to the original K.

Use Adjunction.restrictFullyFaithful on the full inclusions Dbc into the localizing closures and the two concrete restriction lifts. Both commuting comparison isomorphisms are identity isomorphisms, since the restricted functors have the original objects and maps. Unfold the Hom equivalence and the full inclusions: mapping and preimage just wrap and unwrap the same ambient morphism. This proves the displayed equality with adj.homEquiv and retains its naturality.

proof_origin.place: Paragraphs (1)-(2); Lean implementation reuses the proved coefficient-independent finite-open descent lemmas and the existing rational local-factorization statement. The affine-factorization, gluing, compact-support preservation, and full-subcategory adjunction route is retained.

The item statement adds the standing setting of sk-def-sfb-dc-setting, which sk-prop-sf-existence needs for f^! to exist. The worker's counterexample (an infinite disjoint union of Spec k) shows why that setting is needed. Both conclusions are kept and nothing is weakened. Step checks: step 1 uses 01T6 and 01K4 for Noetherian X and Y, and the heart node for Dctf=Dbc. Step 2 uses exact module pullback from sk-prop-sfb-cartesian-coefficients, and the zero check is done on the open cover T×_X U_α. Step 3 builds strata of X with immersion composition (e) and reduced complements (2), takes a common refinement by clause (1), and restricts lisse sheaves by clause (2). Each nonempty stratum lies in some U_α. Step 4 uses det-thm-restriction-local (finite chart cover plus local Dbc) and then clause (1). Step 5 uses the same Rp_*∘j_! as sk-prop-sf-existence and det-sf-comp-coherence-single with Y qcqs. Step 6 is elementary because the subcategories are full. No cycle; proof_deps equals the union of the uses. No new nodes and no duplicates (det-thm-int-restriction-glue is the O_E analogue). I accept all four declared tool_uses. No SGA source. FIX, three repairs: (1) Step 1 now states the Qlb coefficient explicitly as the finite-subextension ring, which matches the master and the heart and local nodes. It differs from C(-,Qlb): x_n=ℓ^{n+1/n}→0 gives a continuous map whose image lies in no finite subextension. Before this, the item silently applied sk-def-localizing-closure and det-sf-comp-coherence-single, whose DAG wording ('ℓ-adic topology') literally gives C(-,Qlb). This is a pre-existing imprecision in those reviewed nodes, outside this delivery, reported to the maintainer: they should cite sk-def-sfb-qlbar-condensed. (2) Step 3 now takes constructibility from the heart node's lisse characterization, not from sk-def-sfb-constructible's local-model definition.
